issuer: Evernorth Holdings Inc. / Pathfinder Digital Assets LLC
evidence_method: SEC EDGAR primary filing text inspected in the public filing viewer. Original raw HTTP bytes were not retained; no SHA-256 raw-byte receipt is claimed. This is a primary-source research reconciliation, not a Barrot ingestion receipt.

historical_cash_xrp_purchase.description: The filing reports approximately $214.0 million of cash used to acquire XRP using proceeds received under Advance Funding Subscription Agreements; approximately $214.8 million of financing cash was received under those agreements.
historical_cash_xrp_purchase.limitation: Historical financing/acquisition, not a current-period spot-flow measure.

ripple_related_party_facility.borrower: Pathfinder Digital Assets LLC (the Company in the filing)
ripple_related_party_facility.repayment_terms: Amounts outstanding became repayable within five business days after the October 9, 2026 business-combination closing, or earlier on five business days' demand by Ripple.
ripple_related_party_facility.reconciliation: The $9.7M includes certain payments Ripple made to third parties on behalf of Pathfinder/Evernorth that were previously recorded as related-party payables and then reclassified as borrowings. The filing does not establish the post-closing settlement status.
ripple_related_party_facility.limitation: Some facility draws funded vendor payments on behalf of Evernorth and were recorded as intercompany receivables/payables; do not classify the full $9.7M as XRP purchases.

ripple_in_kind_xrp_contribution.purpose: The filing says the contributed XRP can be liquidated to fund operating costs for the Company and Pathfinder.
ripple_in_kind_xrp_contribution.limitation: No evidence in this filing that the full amount was sold or transferred to exchanges; do not count as immediate sell pressure.

sbi_affiliated_equity.strategic_investor: The prospectus identifies SBI Holdings as a strategic investor and describes the SBI/Ripple SBI Ripple Asia relationship.
sbi_affiliated_equity.threshold_effect: Certain investors affiliated with SBI Holdings received Class C shares for amounts that would otherwise exceed the 39.9% Class A ownership threshold; Class C shares are convertible under the Pubco governing documents.
sbi_affiliated_equity.cap_table_context: The pro forma table labels a line item 'SBI' with 11,790,952 shares. The excerpt does not supply the full legal entity name for that row; do not equate the row automatically with every SBI-affiliated subscription investor.

eloc.pricing: 97% of VWAP purchase price; purchase timing at Evernorth's discretion and subject to conditions/volume limits.
eloc.internal_filing_disagreement: The cover and illustrative table state approximately $76.8M gross at a $14.71 assumed trading price; one Use of Proceeds paragraph states $80.7M for the same 5,218,935 shares. The table and cover are arithmetically consistent with 5,218,935 × $14.71 ≈ $76.77M. Preserve the $80.7M line as an unresolved filing inconsistency, not a separate financing event.
eloc.issuer_proceeds_distinction: Evernorth says it receives no proceeds from Cantor's subsequent resale to the market, but may receive purchase proceeds when it elects to issue and sell shares to Cantor.
eloc.intended_use: General corporate purposes, including potential XRP acquisition and XRP-ecosystem activity, plus working capital.

public_warrants_and_convertible_notes.limitation: The reviewed filing says warrants had not been exercised and notes had not been converted as of the stated June 30 pro forma measurement; it does not establish subsequent exercise totals.

xrp_per_share_kpi.definition: XRP attributable to Pubco divided by the aggregate Pubco Class A and Class C shares outstanding.
xrp_per_share_kpi.implication: Track both XRP holdings and fully diluted share structure. Equity issuance can dilute XRP per share even when total XRP held increases.

custody_and_ecosystem_intentions.stated_all_xrp_custody: The prospectus says all Evernorth XRP is held through BitGo Trust.
custody_and_ecosystem_intentions.rlUSD_xrp_amm: The company intends to use RLUSD in XRP-based DeFi activities, including potential RLUSD/XRP AMM liquidity.
custody_and_ecosystem_intentions.deployment_timing: The prospectus says material XRP ecosystem deployment was not anticipated before Q4 2026; the document describes intended strategy, not proof of completed deployment.
custody_and_ecosystem_intentions.cash_capital_direct_to_projects: The prospectus says Pubco did not then plan to invest cash capital directly into XRP ecosystem projects; it intended to deploy a portion of existing XRP holdings.

secondary_73_7m_share_claim.note: The two reviewed SEC prospectuses disclose distinct instruments: 5,218,935 ELOC shares and 11,499,992 public-warrant shares, while also listing other potential share classes. A secondary AI summary's approximately 73.7M-share figure was not reconciled to a single primary filing block and must not be treated as actual issued shares, cash proceeds or XRP sales.

forecast_impact: No directional forecast. Treat ELOC/warrants as contingent equity-supply events; treat the Ripple facility and in-kind XRP contribution separately from external cash and exchange flows.
